partA.name: 5-Minute / 300-Tick Initial Risk Score Stability
partA.expected: Scores remain 100% stable over 5 minutes of continuous sensor updates without drift
partA.actual: Scores remained exactly identical at every 60s interval
partA.evidence: t=0s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%] | t=60s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%] | t=120s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%] | t=180s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%] | t=240s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%] | t=300s: [Athero=12%, Ischem=0%, Arrhyth=0%, HTN=6%, HF=4%]

partA.name: Navigation and Theme Toggle Stability
partA.expected: Navigation between views and theme toggling preserves scores completely
partA.actual: Scores remained identical across all views and light/dark theme toggles
partA.evidence: Before: Athero=12%, HF=4% | After: Athero=12%, HF=4%

partA.name: Input-Driven Risk Updates
partA.expected: Relevant inputs update corresponding sub-scores while non-dependent sub-scores remain unaffected
partA.actual: Systolic BP 115->165 mmHg increased HTN risk (6% -> 65%), TC 180->280 mg/dL increased Athero risk (12% -> 64%), Arrhythmia remained unchanged (0%)

partA.name: Report and Scenario Integration
partA.expected: Scores update correctly from report fields, and cleanly switch when scenario is selected
partA.actual: Report applied validated inputs (TC=250), Scenario cleanly switched state to CAD Concern (TC=245)
partA.evidence: Report Athero=70%, HTN=61% -> Scenario Athero=72%, HTN=74%

partB.name: Single Report Regression
partB.expected: Single report extracted accurately with correct unit mapping and zero false conflicts
partB.actual: Extracted 5 values, mapped TC=224, HDL=46, SBP=130

partB.name: Multiple Reports from Different Sources
partB.expected: At least 3 different reports processed independently, attributed to respective facilities without discarding valid data
partB.actual: 3 reports from Metropolis, Apollo, Max successfully aggregated into 9 distinct clinical parameters

partB.name: Different Document Formats & Multi-Page Traceability
partB.expected: Handles text PDF, scanned OCR, image, and preserves page-level traceability across multi-page files
partB.actual: Successfully extracted parameters across formats; Fasting Glucose traced to p.4, CAC traced to p.7
partB.evidence: Fasting Glucose Page: 4, CAC Page: 7, Formats parsed: PDF, Scanned, Image

partB.name: Duplicate & Conflicting Parameters Across Reports
partB.expected: Identical values merge without conflict; differing values are flagged for review and never silently overwritten or averaged
partB.actual: Identical TC (210 mg/dL) merged cleanly; differing HDL (46 vs 32 mg/dL) flagged for review and accurately resolved via user selection
partB.evidence: Identical: TC=210 mg/dL (both) | Conflict: HDL (Metropolis: 46 mg/dL vs Apollo: 32 mg/dL) -> Resolved to 32 mg/dL

partB.name: Missing and Invalid Data Handling
partB.expected: Missing fields remain undefined rather than fabricated as 0; unsupported parameters mapped to unmapped fields
partB.actual: Missing biomarkers safely kept undefined; Serum Creatinine and Bilirubin categorized into unmapped fields
partB.evidence: Missing HDL: undefined, Missing CAC: undefined, Unmapped identified: Serum Creatinine, Total Bilirubin

partB.name: Duplicate File and Re-upload Handling
partB.expected: Prevents duplicate processing of same file; allows removing items and retrying failed files independently
partB.actual: Duplicate file rejected with warning, item removed cleanly from queue, failed file retried independently
partB.evidence: Dedup warning: "File "lab_report.pdf" is already in the upload queue.", Queue count after remove: 1, Retry status: processing

partC.name: Existing Analytical Workflow & Patient Report Generation
partC.expected: Integrates validated multi-report data into patient overview, risk engine, and patient report adapter
partC.actual: Full analytical pipeline intact: Risk Score=18 (Low), Condition="Coronary Artery Disease (CAD)", Imaging CAC=110, Contributors=6

partC.name: Core Application Subsystems (15 Scenarios, EchoNext CNN, Waveforms, ApoB)
partC.expected: All 15 scenario presets, EchoNext 1D CNN, PPG/ECG generators, and ApoB models execute without error
partC.actual: All 15 presets valid, EchoNext CNN [NORM=88.2%, MI=4.1%], ApoB panel LDL=133 mg/dL, Waveforms valid
partC.evidence: Presets: 15/15 OK, EchoNext MI Prob: 4.1%, Waveforms: ECG=1000pts, PPG=100pts

partD.name: TypeScript Type Check & Compile
partD.expected: Zero compilation errors or type mismatches
partD.actual: Passes with 0 type errors across all modules (verified via npx tsc --noEmit)

partD.name: Vite Production Build
partD.expected: Clean production build with valid bundle generation
partD.actual: Passes in 1.93s, generated dist/assets cleanly without errors

partD.name: React Render Loops & Effect Dependencies
partD.expected: No infinite render loops, stabilized dependency arrays for report slices
partD.actual: Verified: usePipeline decoupled from sub-scores, DiseaseRiskSection reads centralized slice, PatientReportPage isolated from 1Hz ticks
partD.evidence: No state loops detected; store actions update state deterministically

partD.name: Duplicate File Processing & Async Overwriting
partD.expected: Deduplication in upload queue; independent file slots prevent race conditions
partD.actual: Verified: duplicate names/sizes skipped; mergeExtractedReports aggregates pure results without asynchronous race conditions
partD.evidence: Queue deduplication active; pure merger eliminates async overwrites
